title: Higher-dimensional quantitative bi-Lipschitz parameterization and a scalar-curvature obstruction
exact_target: Find higher-dimensional analogues of the Bonk--Lang theorem on bi-Lipschitz parametrization by Euclidean space, with explicit quantitative control of the bi-Lipschitz constants from the geometric hypotheses. The question asks for a parametrization result, rather than only a continuous or locally topological chart.
